step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows two environments separated by horizontal lines: Cognizant's AWS cloud at the top, and the customer's AWS account below. Cognizant's side contains ENN Service (EC2), S3, and ECR. The customer's side contains Experiment Host (EC2), input artifacts (Framework Code, Domain Code, Config Data), SQS queue, Studio ML Workers (EC2), and Domain Data (S3). Arrows connect ECR and S3 to ENN Service, bidirectional communication between Exp Host and ENN Service, input arrows from code/config to Exp Host, Exp Host output to SQS, Studio ML Workers returning results to Exp Host, and bidirectional flow between Studio ML Workers and Domain Data.
